description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets created by researchers from different locations—the UK, Italy (IT), Germany (DE), the USA, and India (IN)—over the years 2012 through 2022, with an additional “Other” category. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with categories labeled 2012 through 2022 in sequential order, and the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets” on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10⁰ to 10², with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰ and 10¹. Each year contains a grouped set of five bars, one for each researcher location, plus one for “Other.” The bars are colored as follows: UK (red), IT (purple), DE (brown), USA (orange), IN (green), and Other (blue). In 2012, the USA bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 20 datasets, while the UK, IT, DE, and IN bars are very short, near 1 dataset. By 2022, the USA bar is again the tallest, reaching approximately 100 datasets, and the UK bar is also tall, reaching approximately 80 datasets, while the IT, DE, and IN bars remain shorter, at approximately 20, 10, and 5 datasets, respectively. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized.
